variation: a flat evidence workbench where fact, material, and opinion tokens physically pass through initiation, cross-examination, appearance, and sanction stations
palette: paper gray + carbon black + appraisal orange + approval green + procedural blue + sanction red
typography: industrial sans labels with one large claim, direct role labels, thin retrieval underlines, and operative stamps
composition: converging role entrances, a selection dock, a cross-examination shutter, and a summons-triggered consequence cascade
surface: square workbench plates, exposed gates, moving document tokens, and no decorative machine parts
motion: the same legal object changes station: facts enter appraisal, materials pass or fall away at cross-examination, and refusal physically ejects the opinion before refund and penalty handoffs
transition: the fixed workbench header persists while the tracked object advances from fact to material to opinion
